paths.name: motion/react
paths.message: Import `m`, not `motion`: the eager component pulls in the whole feature set and undoes LazyMotion. See README §5.9.

paths.name: motion
paths.message: Import from 'motion/react' (the app's `m` component), not the package root. See README §5.9.

paths.name: framer-motion
paths.message: The app animates through 'motion/react' only — one animation library. See README §5.9.
